## Part One: Lines
```{r}
# Q1: Draw the line y=4x+3 on a plot that ranges (-20,20) on both axes

plot(NULL,
     xlim = c(-20, 20),
     ylim = c(-20, 20),
     xlab = "x",
     ylab = "y",
     main = "Line: y = 4x + 3")

abline(a = 3, b = 4)


# Q2: Label the line appropriately next to itself
text(x = 3, y = 15, labels = "y = 4x + 3", pos = 4)


# Q3: Color the line in an interesting color and make it dashed
abline(a = 3, b = 4, col = "purple", lty = 2, lwd = 2)

```


## Part Two: Protected Lands

Question 1
```{r}
# Read the data 
data <- read.csv("~/Documents/PAI741/Problem Set Four/data/protected_lands.csv")


# Q1: Find mean, standard deviation and range of each variable:
# protected_lands, gdp_percap, tot_gdp_billions

# protected_lands
mean(data$protected_lands)
sd(data$protected_lands)
range(data$protected_lands)

# gdp_percap
mean(data$gdp_percap)
sd(data$gdp_percap)
range(data$gdp_percap)

# tot_gdp_billions
mean(data$tot_gdp_billions)
sd(data$tot_gdp_billions)
range(data$tot_gdp_billions)


# Q2: Create scatterplot where protected_lands is on y,
# gdp_percap is on x. Include title and axis labels

plot(data$gdp_percap, data$protected_lands,
     main = "Protected Lands and GDP Per Capita",
     xlab = "GDP Per Capita",
     ylab = "Protected Lands",
     pch = 16)


# Q3: Create scatterplot where protected_lands is on y,
# tot_gdp_billions is on x. Include title and axis labels

plot(data$tot_gdp_billions, data$protected_lands,
     main = "Protected Lands and Total GDP",
     xlab = "Total GDP (Billions)",
     ylab = "Protected Lands",
     pch = 16)


# Q4: Regress protected_lands on gdp_percap

model1 <- lm(protected_lands ~ gdp_percap, data = data)

summary(model1)


# Q5: Create scatterplot where protected_lands is on y,
# gdp_percap is on x and overlay with best fit line

plot(data$gdp_percap, data$protected_lands,
     main = "Protected Lands and GDP Per Capita",
     xlab = "GDP Per Capita",
     ylab = "Protected Lands",
     pch = 16)

abline(model1, col = "blue", lwd = 2)


# Q6: Regress protected_lands on tot_gdp_billions

model2 <- lm(protected_lands ~ tot_gdp_billions, data = data)

summary(model2)


# Q7: Create scatterplot where protected_lands is on y,
# tot_gdp_billions is on x. Overlay plot with best fit line

plot(data$tot_gdp_billions, data$protected_lands,
     main = "Protected Lands and Total GDP",
     xlab = "Total GDP (Billions)",
     ylab = "Protected Lands",
     pch = 16)

abline(model2, col = "red", lwd = 2)
```
